packageRules.description: The otel log packages are pinned via `replace` directives written by the Dagger SDK codegen. github.com/dagger/otel-go uses log.KeyValue and log.Value, which v0.22.0 removed, so bumping these breaks every module. Renovate cannot tell a deliberate pin from a stale one. See #27.

Go dependencies written by the Dagger Go SDK codegen (`dagger develop`): GraphQL client, querybuilder, OpenTelemetry, grpc, x/sync. Renovate cannot update their go.sum without running the codegen (renovate/artifacts fails), and the SDK pins them to versions it is tested with. They move with the engine version, via `dagger develop`.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in Dagger module Go code, annotated with `// renovate:` above a `// +default="..."` or a `const ... = "..."` (e.g. terraform/main.go, terraform/container.go). An optional @sha256 digest after the value is kept up to date as well (sops/container.go)
